name: ShinyHunters
summary: ShinyHunters is a financially motivated data theft and extortion group with roots in The Com collective — the same ecosystem as Scattered Spider and LAPSUS$. After arrests in June 2024 the group re-emerged in June 2025 with a materially different playbook centered on AI-powered vishing, Salesforce OAuth abuse, and supply chain compromise via third-party integrations. The defining 2026 operation was the Salesforce Aura Campaign, which exploited misconfigured Experience Cloud guest profiles across an estimated 300-400 organizations, claiming over 1.5 billion stolen Salesforce records.

ttps.notes: AI-powered vishing — operators call employees posing as IT helpdesk, directing to victim-branded phishing sites
SSO credential capture followed by MFA device enrollment
Captures MFA codes via real-time phishing proxy
Attacker registers own MFA device after initial credential capture
Anodot authentication token abuse to pivot into BigQuery, Snowflake, other SaaS
Salesforce Experience Cloud /s/sfsites/aura API endpoint exploitation via misconfigured guest profiles
Mullvad VPN used as exfiltration proxy to blend into legitimate commercial VPN traffic
Pure data extortion — encryption not typically deployed

detection_opportunities: Alert on new MFA device enrollment following login from new location or after helpdesk ticket
Detect anomalous Salesforce Aura API endpoint access (/s/sfsites/aura)
Monitor OAuth app consent grants to unknown or newly registered applications
Alert on bulk Salesforce record queries from new infrastructure
Detect Anodot or third-party analytics token abuse
Monitor for Mullvad VPN exit node IPs in authentication logs
Alert on email flood campaigns preceding helpdesk contact (pre-vishing indicator)
